description: This file defines the enum PlatformLabelFormatter which provides utility functions to parse and pretty-print platform labels such as 'macos', 'ios', 'ipados', 'tvos', and 'watchos'. It includes methods to parse raw platform strings into components and to format them into human-readable names with optional version info.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a raw platform label string into a tuple containing a lowercase prefix and an optional version string.

methods.name: pretty
methods.description: Converts a raw platform label string into a human-readable platform name, optionally including major and minor version numbers.
